tools.name: change_flooring
tools.title: Try new flooring
tools.description: Replace the floor in a room photo with new flooring, to preview a renovation (for example 'light oak hardwood', 'large gray porcelain tile', 'herringbone'). Uses one House AI design credit.

floor_style.description: The new floor in plain words, for example 'white oak herringbone'.
floor_style.title: Floor Style

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.
photo_url.title: Photo Url

photo_upload_id.description: The upload_id from get_photo_upload_link, once the user says the photo is uploaded.
photo_upload_id.title: Photo Upload Id

tools.name: empty_room
tools.title: Empty a room
tools.description: Remove the furniture and clutter from a room photo to see the empty space, for decluttering, moving or planning a new layout. Uses one House AI design credit.

photo.description: The room or house photo the user attached in chat. Filled in by the app, not typed.

photo_url.description: A public https link to the photo, if the user gave one instead of attaching it.

tools.title: Find furniture and home decor
tools.description: Search House AI's shop for real furniture and home decor you can buy, like sofas, rugs, lamps, coffee tables, beds or wall art, optionally under a budget. Returns products with prices, sellers and links.

search.description: What to find, for example 'boucle accent chair' or 'jute rug'.
search.title: Search

max_price_usd.description: Optional budget per item, in US dollars.
max_price_usd.title: Max Price Usd

country.description: Two-letter country code for local stores and prices, for example 'US', 'GB', 'AU'.
country.title: Country

tools.name: furnish_empty_room
tools.title: Furnish an empty room
tools.description: Virtual staging: furnish and decorate an empty or bare room from a photo in a chosen style, for a new home, a rental or a listing. Uses one House AI design credit.

style.description: Design style, for example 'Japandi' or 'mid-century modern'.
style.title: Style

notes.description: Anything specific the user asked for, in their words (for example 'keep the fireplace').
notes.title: Notes

tools.name: get_design_style
tools.title: Get a design style's details
tools.description: Details for one House AI design style: its color palette, materials, furniture, textiles, lighting, decor and what to avoid. Use it to explain a style (for example 'what is Japandi?') or to plan a room makeover before redesigning.

style.description: The style name, for example 'Japandi' or 'modern farmhouse'.
style.title: Style

tools.name: get_house_ai_app_link
tools.title: Get the House AI app
tools.description: A link to download the House AI interior design app for iPhone and Android, where the user's designs are saved and they can keep editing rooms, shop the look and try more styles.

tools.name: get_my_credits
tools.title: Check my House AI design credits
tools.description: How many House AI designs the user can still make today or this plan period.

tools.name: get_photo_upload_link
tools.title: Get a photo upload link
tools.description: Make a private link where the user can upload a photo of their room, house or yard from their phone or computer. Use it when the user wants a redesign but hasn't attached a photo and this app can't pass attached photos to tools. After they say it's uploaded, pass the upload_id to the redesign tool.

tools.name: list_my_designs
tools.title: List my House AI designs
tools.description: The user's recent House AI designs (room redesigns, exteriors, paint and flooring previews), newest first, with image links.

tools.name: paint_walls
tools.title: Try a new wall paint color
tools.description: Repaint the walls in a photo of a room or house with a new paint color, to preview a color before painting (for example 'sage green', 'warm white with black trim'). Uses one House AI design credit.

color.description: The paint color in plain words, for example 'soft sage green'.
color.title: Color

space.description: Inside walls or the outside of the house.

style.description: Exterior or landscaping style, for example 'modern farmhouse', 'Mediterranean', 'English garden'.

tools.name: redesign_room

tools.description: AI interior design: redesign, redecorate or remodel a room from a photo of it, in a chosen style (for example a Japandi living room, a modern farmhouse kitchen or a cozy bedroom makeover). Keeps the room's layout and returns a photorealistic image of the new design. Uses one House AI design credit. Needs a photo: attached in chat, a public link, or an upload_id from get_photo_upload_link.

style.description: Design style, for example 'Japandi', 'Scandinavian', 'coastal'. See search_design_styles.
style.title: Style

room_type.description: The room, for example 'living room', 'kitchen', 'bedroom', 'bathroom', 'home office'.
room_type.title: Room Type

color_palette.description: Optional palette, for example 'warm tones', 'earth tones', 'monochrome'.
color_palette.title: Color Palette

renovation.description: True for a bigger remodel that can change finishes and fixtures; false keeps the room's structure.
renovation.title: Renovation

notes.description: Anything specific the user asked for, in their words (for example 'keep the fireplace').

Use it when someone is deciding how to redecorate, remodel or restyle a room, a house front or a yard, or wants style ideas. Returns style names with a short description; pass a name to the redesign tools.

space.description: Rooms inside, the outside of a building, or a yard or garden.

query.description: Optional words to match, like 'warm wood' or 'coastal'.
